title: claude guard probe — what the agent attempted and what it observed

attempted.description: CHECKABLE — what the agent tried to do. Never quote a refused command verbatim: the guard matches command text, so quoting it gets the report itself refused.

outcome.description: JUDGMENT — what the agent observed. Never adjudicated. The guard's OWN records settle whether it fired; this field only shows whether the agent's account agrees with them.
